reasoning: New-onset postpartum severe hypertension with cerebral and visual symptoms, hyperreflexia with clonus, and proteinuria is most consistent with postpartum preeclampsia with severe features; normal platelets, liver enzymes, LDH, and creatinine argue against HELLP syndrome or current major end-organ laboratory dysfunction.
